nodes.label: StandByUs Root Project
nodes.rationale: Top-level Gradle project declaring android.application, kotlin.android, kotlin.compose, hilt, ksp plugins applied with apply false - each subproject declares them explicitly.

nodes.label: StandByUs Settings
nodes.rationale: Repositories: google, mavenCentral, gradlePluginPortal. RepositoriesMode.FAIL_ON_PROJECT_REPOS enforces central resolution. Single :app module.

nodes.label: :app Module Build
nodes.rationale: compileSdk=35, minSdk=31, targetSdk=35, Java 17, Compose enabled. Dependencies: Compose BOM, Hilt, Room, OkHttp, Glance, Coroutines, Coil. ProGuard minification on release.

nodes.label: MainActivity
nodes.rationale: @AndroidEntryPoint ComponentActivity. Entry point with edge-to-edge display, 4-tab bottom navigation (Home/Album/History/Settings), NavHost routing, and celebration overlay integration.

nodes.label: StandByApplication
nodes.rationale: @HiltAndroidApp Application subclass. Eagerly initializes SupabaseService.getDeviceId() on create. Triggers Glance widget update via StandByWidget().updateAll() using CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob+Main).

nodes.label: AppDatabase (Room)
nodes.rationale: Room database with single entity StatusEntity, version=1, exportSchema=false. fallbackToDestructiveMigration() - schema changes wipe data. Write-through cache, not source of truth.

nodes.label: StatusDao
nodes.rationale: Room DAO: getStatus(userId) SELECT, upsertStatus REPLACE on conflict, clearAll DELETE FROM. Single-table access layer.

nodes.label: StatusEntity
nodes.rationale: Room @Entity with tableName=status_cache. Fields: userId (PK), doing, customDoing, feeling, feelingColor, feelingEmoji, note, updatedAt, source. Maps bidirectionally to UserStatus via extension functions.

nodes.label: AlbumPhoto
nodes.rationale: Photo metadata data class (id, deviceId, url, caption, createdAt) with companion fromMap(Map). Used by AlbumRepository for our-story photo album feature.

nodes.label: Doing Enum
nodes.rationale: 12 activity presets in Chinese: WORKING, OVERTIME, STUDYING, SLEEPING, EATING, EXERCISING, COMMUTING, MOVIE, GAMING, DAYDREAMING, BOARD_GAME, CUSTOM. Includes fromDisplayName lookup.

nodes.label: Feeling Enum
nodes.rationale: 16 mood presets in Chinese with emoji, color, gradientStart, gradientEnd: HAPPY, MISSING, KISS, LOVE, RELAXED, HUSTLING, THINKING, WATCHING, SAD, UPSET, ANGRY, ANXIOUS, TIRED, SICK, BORED, SLEEPING. Includes fromDisplayName and fromEmoji lookups.

nodes.label: PairingInfo
nodes.rationale: Pair link data class (pairId, user1Id, user2Id, user1Name, user2Name). Hand-written toMap()/fromMap() serialization. Links exactly two devices.

nodes.label: UserStatus
nodes.rationale: Core domain model for status data. Fields: userId, doing, customDoing, feeling, feelingColor, feelingEmoji, note, updatedAt, source. Hand-written toMap()/fromMap() for JSON via org.json. Used across all layers (Supabase, Room, Widget).

nodes.label: StickerManager
nodes.rationale: Uploads feeling sticker images to Supabase Storage bucket stickers. Reads image bytes from content resolver, generates filename with feeling+UUID, delegates to supabaseService.uploadFile().

nodes.label: SupabaseConfig
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded Supabase project config: SUPABASE_URL, ANON_KEY (publishable), REST_URL (computed). No runtime config or environment variable abstraction.

nodes.label: SupabaseService
nodes.rationale: @Singleton REST client using raw OkHttp (no Supabase Kotlin SDK). Two OkHttpClients: main (5s timeouts, JSON Content-Type, Prefer return=representation) and uploadClient (60s write timeout). Auth via apikey + Bearer headers referencing SupabaseConfig.ANON_KEY. API: getDeviceId (SharedPreferences UUID), create/update/delete (REST), query (GET), uploadFile/deleteFile/getPublicUrl (Storage). JSON via org.json.

nodes.label: AlbumRepository
nodes.rationale: @Singleton repository for shared photo album feature. Uploads photos to Supabase Storage bucket our-story, records metadata in photos table. compressImage() resizes to max 1920px JPEG quality 80. getPhotos() fetches both users photos.

nodes.label: PairingRepository
nodes.rationale: @Singleton repository for device pairing. generatePairingCode() creates 6-char alphanumeric code (excluded ambiguous chars 0/O/1/I). createPairingCode/joinPair/unpair/findPairByUserId/getPairInfo operate on pairs table. Two devices pair without authentication.

nodes.label: StatusRepository
nodes.rationale: @Singleton repository orchestrating full status sync pipeline. updateStatus writes to Supabase (upsert via query-then-create-or-update), Room cache, widget_cache SharedPreferences. observeStatus provides callbackFlow polling at 6s intervals: fetch from Supabase, upsert Room, emit via Flow. Falls back to Room cache on network failure.

nodes.label: AppModule (Hilt DI)
nodes.rationale: Hilt @Module installed in SingletonComponent. Provides @Singleton AppDatabase via Room.databaseBuilder (standbyus_db). Provides StatusDao via database.statusDao(). fallbackToDestructiveMigration for schema changes.

nodes.label: widget_cache SharedPreferences
nodes.rationale: SharedPreferences cache written on every status update with keys: doing, customDoing, feeling, feelingColor, feelingEmoji, note, updatedAt. Glance app widget reads from this cache.

nodes.label: UserStatus <-> StatusEntity Conversion
nodes.rationale: Bidirectional extension function conversion between domain model (UserStatus) and persistence model (StatusEntity). No mapper class - simple extension functions toEntity() and toUserStatus() defined in StatusEntity.kt.

nodes.label: Device-Based Identity
nodes.rationale: No user accounts. UUID stored in supabase_device SharedPreferences serves as device permanent identity (userId). Generated once on first launch, cached in memory. Two devices pair by exchanging 6-char code - no auth required.

nodes.label: Celebration Overlay System
nodes.rationale: Date-based celebration overlay shown once per day. checkCelebrationDay() matches current MM/dd against CelebrationConfig. Full-screen particle animation before main content. Tracked via celebration SharedPreferences.

edges.rationale: settings.gradle.kts explicitly includes :app module.
app/build.gradle.kts applies plugins declared in root build.gradle.kts.
AppModule.provideDatabase() constructs AppDatabase via Room.databaseBuilder.
AppModule.provideStatusDao() calls database.statusDao() to provide StatusDao.
AppDatabase declares StatusEntity in @Database annotation.
AppDatabase defines abstract fun statusDao() returning StatusDao.
StatusDao queries operate on status_cache table mapped to StatusEntity.
StatusEntity.kt imports and references UserStatus in extension conversion functions.
Conversion functions operate on StatusEntity and UserStatus.
Conversion functions create/read UserStatus instances.
SupabaseService references SupabaseConfig constants for URL and ANON_KEY in HTTP request construction.
SupabaseService.getDeviceId() implements the device identity mechanism.
StickerManager.uploadSticker() calls supabaseService.uploadFile() to upload image bytes to storage.
AlbumRepository calls supabaseService methods: uploadFile, create, query, delete, deleteFile for photo CRUD.
AlbumRepository imports AlbumPhoto and calls AlbumPhoto.fromMap() to parse Supabase query results.
PairingRepository calls supabaseService methods: create, query, update, delete on pairs table.
PairingRepository imports PairingInfo and calls PairingInfo.fromMap().
StatusRepository calls supabaseService.query(), .create(), .update() on statuses table.
StatusRepository calls statusDao.upsertStatus(), .getStatus(), .clearAll() for local cache operations.
StatusRepository imports UserStatus, calls .toMap() and UserStatus.fromMap().
StatusRepository.updateWidgetCache() writes status fields to widget_cache SharedPreferences.
StatusRepository calls userStatus.toEntity() and statusEntity.toUserStatus() conversion functions.
StandByApplication injects SupabaseService and calls supabaseService.getDeviceId(this) in onCreate().
MainActivity calls checkCelebrationDay() and conditionally shows CelebrationOverlay composable.
PairingRepository uses device identity (via SupabaseService.getDeviceId) as creatorUserId and userId parameters.
StatusRepository uses device identity for userId-based status queries and updates.

Identical field structure (userId, doing, customDoing, feeling, feelingColor, feelingEmoji, note, updatedAt, source). StatusEntity is persistence model; UserStatus is domain model. Bidirectional conversion functions confirm same concept.
Both use identical hand-written Map serialization pattern (toMap() returning Map<String,Any>, companion fromMap(Map)). Same org.json approach, no Moshi or Kotlinx Serialization.

Both are enum-based preset lists with displayName, companion fromDisplayName lookup, and Chinese display values. Doing has 12 activities; Feeling has 16 moods with additional gradient color properties.
Both data classes use companion fromMap(Map) for hand-written JSON deserialization from Supabase query results.
Both follow the Repository pattern: inject SupabaseService, call Supabase REST API, handle domain model conversion. Both use hand-written JSON serialization.
Both are @Singleton repositories injecting SupabaseService, operating on Supabase tables via raw REST calls with query/create/update/delete pattern.
Both upload files to Supabase Storage via supabaseService.uploadFile(), handling ContentResolver URI reading and MIME type detection.

Both store the same status data fields (doing, customDoing, feeling, feelingColor, feelingEmoji, note, updatedAt). Room cache and widget SharedPreferences serve as redundant local caches for different consumers.

hyperedges.label: Write-Through Status Sync Pipeline
hyperedges.rationale: StatusRepository.updateStatus() writes to three layers in sequence: (1) Supabase REST API via SupabaseService (remote), (2) Room cache via StatusDao.upsertStatus (local persistence), (3) widget_cache SharedPreferences (widget render cache). All three must succeed for a complete update. The poll path reads from Supabase, caches to Room, and emits via Flow.

hyperedges.label: Hand-Written Map Serialization Convention
hyperedges.rationale: All three data models use hand-written toMap()/fromMap() companion functions for JSON serialization via org.json.JSONObject, rather than Moshi or Kotlinx Serialization. This is a project-wide convention - no serialization library is used.

hyperedges.label: Status Preset System
hyperedges.rationale: UserStatus stores feeling and doing as string identifiers that correspond to Feeling enum (16 moods with emoji+colors) and Doing enum (12 activities). The enums provide display names, emoji, and gradient colors consumed by the UI layer for status rendering.
